meta.name: hyperplan
meta.description: Adversarial multi-agent planning skill. Self-orchestrates 5 hostile category members (unspecified-low, unspecified-high, deep, ultrabrain, artistry) via team-mode for ruthless cross-critique debate, distills only the defensible insights, then MANDATORILY hands the distilled insight bundle to the `plan` agent for executable plan formalization. Use when planning needs maximum rigor and surfacing of weak assumptions, blind spots, and over-engineering. Triggers: 'hyperplan', 'hpp', '/hyperplan', 'adversarial plan', 'hostile planning', 'cross-critique plan', '하이퍼플랜', '적대적 계획', '교차 비평'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 召集多个互相对抗的AI反复挑刺,只留下站得住的判断,再整理成可执行方案。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果关键决策容不得想当然,想先被自己的假设挑一遍刺。
copy.tagline_en: Stress-test a plan with adversarial AI critics, then turn the survivors into steps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if a decision is too important to get wrong and you want your assumptions attacked first

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会组建一个 5 名互相敌对的成员团队，就你的规划请求互相攻击，只保留经得起批评的结论，再交给 plan agent 写成可执行计划。
howto.when: 当你提到 “hyperplan”、“hpp”、“/hyperplan” 等关键词，或需要最大限度严谨、暴露薄弱假设与过度设计的规划时触发；需已启用 team 工具。

say.text: 用 hyperplan 规划这次重构，尽量暴露过度设计
say.note: 启动 5 人对抗辩论，只留可辩护结论

say.text: hpp：这套接口设计有哪些薄弱假设？
say.note: 成员交叉批评后交给 plan 出计划

say.text: /hyperplan 帮我评估这个方案要不要换思路
say.note: 会产出替代思路并互相攻击

howto.what_en: Claude forms a 5-member hostile team that cross-attacks your planning request, keeps only defensible insights, then hands them to the plan agent to write an executable plan.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say “hyperplan”, “hpp”, “/hyperplan” etc., or need maximum rigor that surfaces weak assumptions and over-engineering. Requires team tools to be enabled.

say_en.text: Use hyperplan to plan this refactor and surface over-engineering
hpp: what weak assumptions does this API design rest on?
say_en.note: Cross-critique, then the plan agent writes the plan

say_en.text: /hyperplan — should we rethink this approach entirely?
